title: Amplifier
text: Model amplifier in RF systems, {Source of amplifier gain} sets Amplifier; {Available power gain}, {Open circuit voltage gain}, {Data source}, {Polynomial coefficients}, {AM/AM-AM/PM table} sets the lookup table -10, 20, -2; {Network-parameter object} sets the network parameter objects as data source, {Network parameter type}, {Input impedance (Ohm)}, {Output impedance (Ohm)}, {Data file} sets the name of network parameter data file, {Frequency (dB)} sets the frequency of network parameters, {Reference Impedance(Ohm)} sets the reference impedance of network parameters, {Use rational object} sets the rational object as data source, {Residues}, {Poles} sets the residues in order of rational model, {Direct feedthrough}, {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the ground RF circuit terminals, {Nonlinear polynomial type} sets the type of nonlinearity Even, {Intercept points convention}, {IP2} sets the second-order intercept point, {IP3} sets the third-order intercept point, {1-dB gain compression power}, {Output saturation power}, {Gain compression at saturation}, {Use operation frequency at maximum S21 magnitude}, {Operation frequency}, {Use constant S21 and nonlinearity} sets the operation frequency, {Plot Power Characteristics} sets the amplifier nonlinear power curve visualization, {Simulate noise} sets the simulate thermal noise, {Noise type}, {Noise distribution}, {Noise figure (dB)}, {Frequencies} sets the frequency data, {Minimum noise figure (dB)}, {Optimal reflection coefficient}, {Equivalent normalized noise resistance}, {Automatically estimate impulse response duration}, {Impulse response duration}, {Modeling options} sets the model S-parameters Time, {Fitting options} sets the rationalfit fitting options Fit, {Relative error desired (dB)} sets the relative error acceptable for the rational, {Use only S-parameter magnitude with appropriate delay}, {Source of frequency data} sets the frequency data source Extracted from data, {Frequency data}, {Plot type} sets the type of data plot, {Parameter 1} sets the type of S-Parameters, {Parameter 2} sets the type of S-Parameters to plot, {Format1} plots format Magnitude, {Format2} plots format Magnitude, {Y-axis scale}, {X-axis scale} and {Plot}. Values come from the instance.
